tools.description: Search for posts in Mattermost using both semantic (AI-powered) and keyword search. Semantic search finds posts by meaning and does not require exact term matches. Keyword search treats the query as a literal AND match — every whitespace-separated token must appear in the same post — so prefer short, focused queries (1-2 key terms) over long multi-word phrases. Parameters: query (required), team_id (optional), channel_id (optional). semantic_limit/semantic_offset control semantic results (default: 10). keyword_limit/keyword_offset control keyword results (default: 10). You can make separate calls with different queries optimized for each search type (e.g., a natural language query for semantic and specific keywords for keyword search). To find posts mentioning a specific person, query their username only (e.g. `john.smith`); at-mentions in posts use the username, never the display name. Do not combine username and display name (e.g. `john.smith John Smith`) in a single query — that requires all of those tokens to co-occur and will miss most posts. Optional structured filters (keyword search only): from (username), in (channel name or ID), before/after (YYYY-MM-DD date). Returns matching posts with content, author, channel, and relevance score for semantic results. Results show individual matching posts — to see the full conversation around a result, use read_channel with the channel_id.

team_id.description: Optional team ID to limit search scope,minLength=26,maxLength=26

channel_id.description: Optional channel ID to limit search to a specific channel,minLength=26,maxLength=26

from.description: Optional username — only posts from this user (keyword search only),maxLength=64

in.description: Optional channel name or ID — only posts in this channel (keyword search only),maxLength=64

before.description: Optional date YYYY-MM-DD — only posts before this date (keyword search only)

after.description: Optional date YYYY-MM-DD — only posts after this date (keyword search only)

semantic_limit.description: Max results from semantic search (default 10; max 50),minimum=1,maximum=50

keyword_limit.description: Max results from keyword search (default 10; max 100),minimum=1,maximum=100
